target_statement: Distill exact reusable theorem schemas that subsume multiple proved results or scoped obstructions in the full project corpus.
first_unproved_edge: For each proposed abstraction, prove the exact statement from recorded hypotheses without silently upgrading any scoped source result.
mask_or_node_class: Statement-dependent; actual-prime claims remain actual-prime and synthetic/operator claims remain abstract.
source_data_retained: Explicitly recorded per theorem; no theorem may infer source localization from a source-free normalization.
coefficient_cone_and_sign: Explicitly recorded per theorem; signed, nonnegative, and operator-valued statements are not interchanged.
normalization: Inherited exactly from each source theorem or made intrinsic in an abstract theorem.
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: QP/Turan statements retain the full recorded band and floor; operator statements state their own form-domain metric.
quantifier_order: All universal/adaptive/existential orders are preserved; finite diagnostics are excluded from asymptotic theorem premises.
resolution_required: Any QP transport retains B^-1 resolution; no such field is asserted for unrelated operator theorems.

rate_and_exponent_ledger.target_exponent: no new strip exponent is claimed
all_exponent_losses: must be copied exactly from source reports
cross-architecture abstractions carry no exponent reward

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: Each positive theorem must include an explicit factorization/witness; each no-go must include an exact model.
downstream_socket: Research-method pruning and reusable operator/convex-analysis lemmas only; no direct zero-free-strip or RH socket is claimed.
why_not_target_renamed: The output is a theorem taxonomy with proofs and countermodels, not a renamed strip, propagation, or Ward target.
abstract_convex_falsifier: Test every passport-free or moment-only statement on Fejer/coisometry/adaptive convex systems.
fejer_falsifier: Reject structural conclusions invariant under arbitrary Sidon-seed Fejer autocorrelations.
prime_density_pseudonode_falsifier: Reject actual-prime conclusions whose proof survives the smooth matched-node models unchanged.
finite_actual_prime_diagnostic: Used only to check identities and locate assumptions, never to promote an asymptotic claim.
actual_prime_arithmetic_line: Required only for any theorem explicitly claiming actual-prime strength; otherwise none is claimed.
decision_tree_change_if_proved: Compress repeated failures into reusable impossibility theorems and isolate minimal positive hypotheses for each live branch.
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: Remove the proposed abstraction and retain only the separately scoped source results.
stop_rule: Stop a candidate if it mixes architectures, loses a passport field, restates an open target, or lacks either a proof from recorded results or an exact countermodel.
